name: AirAsia
verdict: Airline brand of AirAsia Group Berhad, listed in Malaysia; co-founders Tony Fernandes and Kamarudin Meranun are substantial shareholders. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: AirAsia's listed parent (AirAsia X Berhad, now AirAsia Group Berhad, Bursa Malaysia) consolidated all group airlines in January 2026 by buying 100% of AirAsia Berhad and AirAsia Aviation Group; co-founders Fernandes and Meranun remain substantial shareholders directly and indirectly (airasia-group-berhad-ownership). No state or state-fund owner in the chain, and no court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against the company within METHOD's scope was found. The 2015-2020 Airbus bribery affair, in which AirAsia executives were named, is bribery/corruption, which METHOD.md excludes, so no claim was written for it. Ripper GC partner since April 2025 (AirAsia newsroom, 2025-04-30); still on the team page 2026-10-03.
